parameters.query:
-- Catch-up schedule (docs: workflows/README.md). The trigger fires hourly 08:00-20:00 on weekdays;
-- only the first successful run of the day does any work. The execution mode ('trigger' for the
-- schedule, 'cli', 'manual') is read from n8n's own table (verified on n8n 2.42.7).
SELECT coalesce((SELECT mode FROM n8n.execution_entity WHERE id = $1::int), 'unknown') AS mode,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('succeeded', 'partial')) > 0 AS ran_today,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'running' AND started_at > now() - interval '2 hours') > 0 AS running,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')::int AS failed_today
  FROM jobs.runs
 WHERE (started_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Santiago')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Santiago')::date;

SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(offer_id), '[]'::jsonb) AS known
  FROM jobs.offers WHERE last_seen > now() - interval '60 days';

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ queries: $('Config').first().json.config.queries, days: $('Config').first().json.config.daysBack, pages: $('Config').first().json.config.pages, max_details: $('Config').first().json.config.optionalMaxDetails, known_ids: $json.known }) }}

SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'offer_id', offer_id, 'title', title, 'company', company,
           'region', region, 'first_seen', first_seen) ORDER BY first_seen), '[]'::jsonb) AS existing
  FROM jobs.offers
 WHERE first_seen > now() - interval '60 days' AND duplicate_of IS NULL;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ candidates: $('Combine').first().json.offers.map(o => ({ offer_id: o.offer_id, title: o.title, company: o.company, region: o.region })), existing: $json.existing }) }}

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT x.*, d.duplicate_of
      FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
               offer_id text, source text, url text, title text, company text, location_raw text,
               region text, published_at date, description text, structured jsonb, raw jsonb,
               content_hash text)
      LEFT JOIN jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS d(offer_id text, duplicate_of text) USING (offer_id)
), previous AS (
    SELECT o.offer_id, o.content_hash FROM jobs.offers o JOIN input i USING (offer_id)
), upsert AS (
    INSERT INTO jobs.offers AS o (offer_id, source, url, title, company, location_raw, region, published_at,
                                  description, structured, raw, content_hash, first_run_id, duplicate_of)
    SELECT offer_id, source, url, title, company, location_raw, region, published_at,
           description, structured, raw, content_hash, $3::uuid, duplicate_of
      FROM input
    ON CONFLICT (offer_id) DO UPDATE SET
        url = EXCLUDED.url, title = EXCLUDED.title, company = EXCLUDED.company,
        location_raw = EXCLUDED.location_raw, region = EXCLUDED.region,
        published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at, description = EXCLUDED.description,
        structured = EXCLUDED.structured, raw = EXCLUDED.raw, content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash,
        last_seen = now(), duplicate_of = coalesce(o.duplicate_of, EXCLUDED.duplicate_of)
    RETURNING 1
)
-- Data-modifying CTEs always run to completion; previous reflects the state before the upsert.
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source', source, 'new', new, 'updated', updated)), '[]'::jsonb)
       AS counts
  FROM (SELECT i.source,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.offer_id IS NULL)::int AS new,
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.offer_id IS NOT NULL AND p.content_hash <> i.content_hash)::int AS updated
          FROM input i LEFT JOIN previous p USING (offer_id)
         GROUP BY i.source) per_source;

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS x(source text, fetched int, errors int, error_sample text)
), counts AS (
    SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS c(source text, new int, updated int)
), s AS (
    INSERT INTO jobs.run_sources (run_id, source, fetched, new, updated, errors, error_sample)
    SELECT $1::uuid, st.source, st.fetched, coalesce(c.new, 0), coalesce(c.updated, 0), st.errors,
           nullif(st.error_sample, '')
      FROM stats st LEFT JOIN counts c USING (source)
    RETURNING fetched, errors
)
UPDATE jobs.runs
   SET finished_at = now(),
       status = CASE WHEN (SELECT sum(errors) FROM s) = 0 THEN 'succeeded'
                     WHEN (SELECT sum(fetched) FROM s) > 0 THEN 'partial'
                     ELSE 'failed' END
 WHERE run_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING run_id, status, extract(epoch FROM finished_at - started_at)::int AS seconds;
